name: koru-autopilot-cursor
description: Bridge between Cursor and the koru autopilot daemon. Standalone VSIX dedicated to Cursor IDE; sibling VSIX packages cover VS Code, VSCodium, Windsurf and Antigravity so a regression in this plugin cannot leak into another IDE's runtime.

commands.title: koru: Send text to active chat

koruAutopilot.socketPath.description: Unix socket override. Empty = KORU_AUTOPILOT_SOCKET, else KORU_AUTOPILOT_INSTANCE / XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (matches koru Python).

koruAutopilot.chatOpenCommands.description: Commands to open Cursor Composer/chat, tried in order. Empty = plugin defaults (composer.openComposer first, etc).

koruAutopilot.autoConnect.description: Connect to the daemon automatically when Cursor starts.

koruAutopilot.probeLadder.description: Try chat commands in order with focus/paste verification; cache winning command IDs.

koruAutopilot.probeFocusDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after a focus-open command before verifying UI state.

koruAutopilot.probePasteDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after paste before checking the text did not land in a file editor.

koruAutopilot.submitClickX.description: Optional absolute screen X coordinate for clicking the chat Send button after paste. Use command `koru: Capture submit button position`.

koruAutopilot.submitClickY.description: Optional absolute screen Y coordinate for clicking the chat Send button after paste. Use command `koru: Capture submit button position`.

koruAutopilot.chatHistoryWatch.description: Poll Cursor's chat-history SQLite DB and forward newly observed assistant messages as 'message.received' events to the koru daemon. Without this, koru cannot tell whether the IDE-side LLM has answered, asked a follow-up question, or finished the task.

koruAutopilot.chatHistoryPollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to poll Cursor's chat-history SQLite DB for new assistant messages.

koruAutopilot.skipWhenInputBusy.description: Before pasting into chat, probe via select-all + copy to detect un-submitted text in the chat input. When non-empty, skip the drive instead of clobbering the user's reply or concatenating prompts. Disable to restore the legacy 'always paste on top' behavior.

koruAutopilot.submitHostKey.description: Host-level key combo used to submit the chat after paste. 'auto' picks Ctrl+Return for Cursor (where plain Return inserts a newline). Override to force a specific key.

koruAutopilot.verifySubmit.description: After every submit candidate, probe the chat input via select-all + copy AND cross-check `cursorDiskKV` for a fresh `type=1` (user) bubble. If neither confirms submission, discard the cached winner and try the next candidate.

koruAutopilot.verifySubmitOnCursor.description: Deprecated alias for koruAutopilot.verifySubmit (kept for settings migration).

koruAutopilot.reloadOnVersionMismatch.description: When the koru daemon rejects this plugin because the installed VSIX version does not match the daemon's expected version, run `Developer: Reload Window` automatically so the freshly installed VSIX gets loaded. The plugin enforces a 60s cooldown so it never reloads more than once per minute. Set to false to keep the manual recovery (status bar shows `koru: reload`).

scripts.test: npm run compile && node out/dispatch-plan.test.js && node out/probe-ladder.test.js && node out/step-decisions.test.js && node out/host-click-submit.test.js && node out/chat-history-watcher.test.js && node out/ack-payload.test.js && node out/ides/cursor.test.js
